$comment: Game-text overrides for scripts/generate-game-names-i18n.mjs: ids the game has no term for, and terms the game gets wrong. Keep it small; each entry says why.

extraIds.tauBroadside: Not in the game's lineup yet (an upcoming MoW the home screen can feature); its name comes from the game's Units/ terms.

Mounted.why: No Traits/ term in the game.

SlayEnemiesWithHeroToTraitInOneBattle_de.why: The game's singular form drops "in one battle" (en, es, fr).
SlayEnemiesWithHeroToTraitInOneBattle_de.en: [i2p_Plural]Defeat {[KILL_AMOUNT]} enemies that have the {[TRAIT]} trait with {[HERO_NAME]} in one battle[i2p_One]Defeat {[KILL_AMOUNT]} enemy that has the {[TRAIT]} trait with {[HERO_NAME]} in one battle
SlayEnemiesWithHeroToTraitInOneBattle_de.es: [i2p_Plural]Derrota a {[KILL_AMOUNT]} enemigos que tengan el rasgo de {[TRAIT]} con {[HERO_NAME]} en una batalla.[i2p_One]Derrota a {[KILL_AMOUNT]} enemigo que tenga el rasgo de {[TRAIT]} con {[HERO_NAME]} en una batalla.
SlayEnemiesWithHeroToTraitInOneBattle_de.fr: [i2p_Plural]Vaincre {[KILL_AMOUNT]} ennemis dotés du trait {[TRAIT]} avec {[HERO_NAME]} en un seul combat[i2p_One]Vaincre {[KILL_AMOUNT]} ennemi doté du trait {[TRAIT]} avec {[HERO_NAME]} en un seul combat

SlayEnemiesWithHeroToUnitEffectInOneBatt.why: Every locale of the game names the effect twice and never the hero; de/es/fr follow the wording of their own UnitEffect_description template.
SlayEnemiesWithHeroToUnitEffectInOneBatt.en: Defeat {[KILL_AMOUNT]} enemies with {[HERO_NAME]} while under the {[UNIT_EFFECT]} effect in one battle
SlayEnemiesWithHeroToUnitEffectInOneBatt.de: Besiege mit {[HERO_NAME]} unter dem Effekt „{[UNIT_EFFECT]}“ in einem Kampf {[KILL_AMOUNT]} Gegner
SlayEnemiesWithHeroToUnitEffectInOneBatt.es: Derrota a {[KILL_AMOUNT]} enemigos con {[HERO_NAME]} bajo el efecto de {[UNIT_EFFECT]} en una batalla.
SlayEnemiesWithHeroToUnitEffectInOneBatt.fr: Vaincre {[KILL_AMOUNT]} ennemis avec {[HERO_NAME]} sous l'effet {[UNIT_EFFECT]} en un seul combat
